edges.notes: SPIR-V is used as a portable device IR in OpenCL 2.1+ specification tracks (Khronos).
AMD ships OpenCL implementations as part of ROCm / AMD GPU software stacks on supported platforms.
Substitutable GPU/accelerator compute APIs in many deployment classes (OpenCL vs CUDA).
Typical OpenCL ICD + vendor drivers run on Linux hosts.
SYCL is a Khronos C++ programming model that commonly lowers to OpenCL backends among other options.
